title: Edible Seeds
description: Seeds are edible now. That’s it. That’s the Data Pack.  Honestly, why weren’t they before?
body:
# Edible Seeds

Have you ever had a craving for some beetroot seeds?

That's not important.

What *is* important is that seeds should be edible. People eat them all the time. Now you can too.

Don't believe me? Check out the gallery. (it's just me eating seeds)
